_meta.note: The probe watch's strings, merged over layer zero's pack at load. Every key starts with `probewatch.`.

strings.probewatch.probe_drier: For {hours:.0f} of the last 24 hours, {bed}'s probe at {depth:.0f} cm read drier than the probes beside it, the rain and the air say it should, by about {points:.1f} points of water content. Check it: moved, out of the soil, an air gap around it, or drifting.
strings.probewatch.probe_drier.us: For {hours:.0f} of the last 24 hours, {bed}'s probe at {depth:.0f} inches read drier than the probes beside it, the rain and the air say it should, by about {points:.1f} points of water content. Check it: moved, out of the soil, an air gap around it, or drifting.
strings.probewatch.probe_drier_both: For {hours:.0f} of the last 24 hours, {bed}'s probe at {depth:.0f} cm read drier than the probe beside it, the rain and the air say it should, by about {points:.1f} points of water content. With two probes in the bed, which one is off cannot be told: check both, moved, out of the soil, an air gap around it, or drifting.
strings.probewatch.probe_drier_both.us: For {hours:.0f} of the last 24 hours, {bed}'s probe at {depth:.0f} inches read drier than the probe beside it, the rain and the air say it should, by about {points:.1f} points of water content. With two probes in the bed, which one is off cannot be told: check both, moved, out of the soil, an air gap around it, or drifting.
strings.probewatch.probe_drier_likely: For {hours:.0f} of the last 24 hours, {bed}'s probe at {depth:.0f} cm read drier than the probe beside it, the rain and the air say it should, by about {points:.1f} points of water content. Of the two it is the likelier one off: judged against the rain and the air alone, it still is, and the other is not. Check it: moved, out of the soil, an air gap around it, or drifting.

But the other, at {other:.0f} cm, is the likelier one off: judged against the rain and the air alone, it is, and this one is not. Check that one first.
